title.narrative: Business partnerships and solutions for the Sustainable Development Goals

description.narrative: This One UN project focuses on SDG positive business practices to support SDG/EU green agenda opportunities addressing private companies of two sectors (textiles and agro-processing). This project aims to raise awareness on SDGs and, according to the Resident Coordinator, it is preparatory assistance for a larger scale joint project to be funded by Sweden in Albania.
